title: Review (Weak): on fresh seeds 21-22 the high-yield allele ends higher in the up arm than in its identical-event twin (K2 share 0.93/0.78 vs 0.46/0.30), but the up sweep is lost and re-arises on seed 22, the twin drifts to 0.3-0.46, and the 'wall' channel is a contour
summary: labkit runs of membrane_evo_up and its identical-event twin membrane_evo on seeds 21 and 22 (128^2, t=40000). Cells form from noise and divide (persistent splits 7-14, max generation 2-4, merge/split <= 0.24). Final K2 biomass share up vs twin: 0.931 vs 0.455 (seed 21) and 0.776 vs 0.301 (seed 22); in the up arm of seed 22 K2 rose to 0.91 by t~15k, was lost entirely by t~25-30k and re-arose to 0.78 by mutation, and the twin drifts to 0.30-0.46. The up arm's K2 cells are visibly larger. The channel labkit calls the membrane is 4 phi (1 - phi), a contour of the order parameter; the independently transported link layer L is membrane-like in the twin arm only.

observations.S: rerun/up/seed21/sheet.png t=0: noise over the whole domain
observations.D: rerun/up/seed21-22 and twin: persistent splits 7-14, max generation 2-4
observations.H: k2share.json: final K2 share up 0.931/0.776 vs identical-event twin 0.455/0.301 (seeds 21/22)
observations.B: not supported: the 'membrane (wall)' channel is 4 phi(1-phi) (world.py fields), a contour; L link is membrane-like only in the twin runs

seeds_run.result: pass at the end (0.78 vs 0.30) but the up sweep was lost once (0 at t~25-30k) and re-arose

controls_run.H: rerun/twin/seed21-22 (membrane_evo, the identical-event twin with equal yields), same seeds and duration

verdicts.limitation: Two fresh seeds, end-point shares only; I did not separate births from disk-cut fragments (the claim's own caveat: the sweep runs through fragments made by the imposed death disk), so H stays disturbance-mediated. B is not supported by these runs (contour channel; L layer absent in the up arm aggregate).
